description: Realized PnL of one Hyperliquid wallet over time: buckets with realized PnL and fees paid in each, by default daily over the last 30 days. Add the buckets up for a running PnL curve. Realized only: unrealized PnL on open positions is in get_user_state. For totals over a range use get_user_summary.

bucket_ms.description: Bucket size in milliseconds: 3600000 for hourly, 86400000 for daily (default)

from.description: Window start: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default 30 days ago

to.description: Window end: Unix ms or seconds, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), or relative (-7d, -24h, now). Default now

name: get_user_pnl_series

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

title: Wallet PnL curve
